body:
First independently identified and reproduced 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`; earlier occurrence unknown. Affects [PR #1366](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/1366), merge `f513f7d6cb5fb088c1fca0238d915426a14ecfa8`, head `a07fc3c29412af32d8b9f734386570be719b3791`. Preserve closed/released original #1358's single-PR history. Parent #1268 stays open, along with its separate source/authority work; this additive correction does not extend the original budget.

Inspected all79 immutable originals,13 declared baseline files plus the actual consumed predecessor manifest, all16 whole NPZ archives/128 decoded member CRCs/hashes,32 native metadata bodies,64 COG HEAD records, eight complete 2019/2020 discovery snapshots with terminal pagination,30 outputs/48 source descriptors/68 metric bindings. The whole raw/decoded original-baseline union is117,093,481 bytes and all files fit32MiB. Two actual isolated unchanged full analysis runs match the retained report SHA `fe903fb95a88c06236f0dba092275421a7eae480ec8c53c696d52d8f74d65f41`. A separate implementation imports no candidate code and independently matches all496 measurements plus all1,751,344 sampled scene pixel locations and original component/contact geometry memberships; reported20/21 candidate and8/10 overlap concordance remains supported as an optical screen.

Actual actionable findings:

1. **Incomplete source/scene/code admission.** The analysis authenticates NPZ bytes against its mutable local receipt, then checks only total row count. In an owned complete copy, replace the last receipt record (`S2B_34KDF_20200811_0_L2A`) with a second first-scene record. The unchanged actual CLI exits0 and writes496 rows containing only465 unique subject×scene identities: one required scene is missing and another duplicated. In a separate actual complete NPZ, OR bit31 into one component membership and bit10 into that pixel's contact membership; refresh the receipt's real file size/hash. The unchanged CLI exits0, accepting out-of-contract memberships. It never re-derives geometry membership from original row/col/native affine values. Changing actual executed code's Green reflectance scale from0.0001 to0.00011 also exits0 with the original manifest unchanged. An NPZ byte change with its old receipt is correctly rejected; preserve that existing protection, but bind the actual receipt, selected scene roster, geometry/predecessor manifest and complete executed code closure to immutable external pins. These are rejection gaps; original retained rows and memberships actually are correct.
2. **Unsafe reproduction destinations.** After full calculation the analysis uses `ROOT / --output` plus overwrite-capable `write_bytes`. Actual entrypoint probes overwrite an occupied ordinary sentinel, follow a dangling output link/live linked ancestor and accept `../` traversal, creating reports in outside-packet owned scratch. A real OS file-size failure leaves a1024-byte partial report after calculation. The full unchanged offline `select_scenes.py` also overwrites its existing selected-scene sentinel and follows a dangling destination. The extractor's actual `deterministic_npz` writer opens ZIPs with mode `w`; actual calls overwrite an ordinary sentinel and create an outside-packet scratch target through a dangling link. Query/metadata acquisition and other extractor writers were inspected as adjacent overwrite-capable paths but their remote entrypoints were not rerun. Apply complete fresh destination admission across acquisition, selection, extraction, analysis and receipt/result writers rather than fixing only one CLI path. All probes used this Auditor's private copies; no original or other worker was touched.
3. **Unreconciled sensing-time evidence.** Four2019-wet catalog/tile-info timestamps differ materially from their retained native granule XML `SENSING_TIME`; the496 report uses the catalog time without presenting that conflict. Example `S2B_33KZA_20190221_0_L2A`: catalog `2019-02-21T09:18:35.457000Z`, granule `2019-02-21T09:05:22.793457Z`, delta792.663543s. The remaining three deltas are866.957175s (`34KBF`),336.761901s (`34KCF`),63.992610s (`34KDF`,23Feb). Other12 scenes differ only by sub-millisecond precision. All calendar dates/season bins remain unchanged. Preserve both raw vintages and define/reconcile source-specific time fields; do not silently treat a catalog proxy as the native sensing time or infer an upstream cause without evidence.

Reproduce the changed complete fixtures against the unchanged actual CLI in an admitted isolated namespace, preserving old authentic originals. Verify the full native row/col/geometry memberships and exact31×16 identity matrix, not only counts or a candidate-created hash. Use genuine occupied/dangling/ancestor/traversal and late-write-failure destinations only inside owned scratch. Retain actual complete altered source/code/receipt files and truthful exit/output observations. No stubbed producer or deliberately thrown pass proof was used.

Success criteria:

- Add a new bounded integrity successor under the declared disjoint path, at most two focused PRs. Preserve all79 originals,21 component and ten contact geometries/identities,16 native scenes, both historical reports, all raw source/date/ETag/window/code pins, failed attempts and explicit unknowns. Preserve #1358/#1268/#1437/#1462/#1499 ownership and budgets.
- Bind and consume the exact immutable original manifest, selected16 unique scene identities, complete source/window receipts, all expected array inventories/types/grid values, predecessor geometry/manifest and actual executed code/module bytes before computation. Require exactly one unique31-mask×16-scene row for every expected pair; reject missing/duplicate/foreign scenes/subjects/bits, wrong actual memberships, coherent receipt/hash drift and executable drift. Preserve existing raw-window drift rejection and useful synthetic/observed controls.
- Derive complete pixel inventory and component/contact membership from all unchanged original geometries/native grids. Reconcile all496 records and31 summaries against actual complete data; distinguish nominal-grid consistency from independent ground-control accuracy. Keep masks limited to candidate-union/contact intersections and counts nonadditive.
- Admit every complete destination set before mutation; reject occupied paths, literal/ancestor symlinks and escaped destinations, use fresh exclusive result namespaces and install a full completion receipt last. Exercise actual analysis and adjacent selection/extractor/receipt writers, failed writes after calculation and all modified/missing input/code/identity probes; preserve sentinels and failed attempts without passed completion.
- Preserve both native granule and catalog/tile-info time fields with actual provenance and explicit discrepancy flags; independently reconcile all16 products/tiles/baselines/geotransforms. Show what124 affected2019-wet rows mean, preserve observed pixel results and seasonal bins, and make no unsupported statement about the cause of the discrepancy.
- Execute the frozen corrected complete local analysis twice and compare actual full output bytes with retained originals or explain an independently supported result difference. No whole-COG hash, new source authority, registration accuracy or boundary/physical/legal approval may be inferred. Fresh remote acquisition, if needed, must receive honest complete byte/runtime admission and respect original partial-window scope.

Complete16-page all-state inventory (1518 issue/PR entries), complete scoped main history and six complete open-PR file inventories show no S2-specific correction or owner of the new path. #1437's closed geometry/operand successors, open #1462 JRC accounting, open #1499 treaty citation and #1397 official-map work remain distinct. This issue depends only on closed/released #1358; source/authority unknowns allowed in the original bounded assessment are not replaced by a broad readiness wait.

Limits: independent verification uses all actual retained DN windows and original nominal-grid geometry, not a fresh full remote COG recapture or ground-control survey. The original721 recorded HTTP206 range responses and64 source paths/ETags were inspected, not called new execution. Whole COG files were never downloaded/hashed in this audit. Copernicus product documentation/legal notice were checked, without approving mirror terms, lawful applicability, geography, history, physical status, boundary ownership or imports. No implementation, merge or deployment was performed. The bounded source-only integrity successor must preserve those limits.

Exact whole-byte bindings follow. Original aliases use baseline `c53f0aa473eb32c07a5cf4f57df3a86663a625ae`; packet paths use the affected merge. Predecessor geometry/manifest paths use that baseline. Repeated identical run hashes retain separate paths.
